outlet: WA Secretary of State election results, precinct export
notes: Walla Walla County precinct results, November 5, 2024 general. 'Walla Walla County Commissioner District 1' and 'Walla Walla County Commissioner District 2' each appear on all 62 precincts that report any race (the same 62 as the statewide offices), totals 28,609 and 22,440 votes.
